description: Skelet P10-A: product/version gallery UI over qualified gallery reads (no new backend)

compatibility.instructions: Does this grain preserve all contracts: new /gallery page plus gallery-ui source tests only; gallery REST/MCP/DB untouched; boards/lens/search/flows unchanged; no schema, migration, donor import, or permission change? Any changed behavior?

correctness.instructions: Is the UI factually correct: lists /api/v1/products with limit/cursor pagination; inspects /api/v1/products/{id}/versions; renders uri/title/versionCount/artifactCount and uri/productId/versionNo/artifactCount; client-side title filter; bearer auth; cursor pagination; no-oracle empty states; stable skelet:// identifiers?

evidence.instructions: Is evidence sufficient: 5 gallery-ui source tests pass; full web suite 111/111 green; lint/typecheck clean; production build includes /gallery; graft build/check green; no mock data; artifact-level inspection honestly deferred to flow player/search?

reliability.instructions: Any reliability risk: unrecognized-shape fail-closed; HTTP/network failures announced; loading/empty/filtered states; pagination cursors; no hardcoded credentials; no invented pagination semantics beyond the qualified routes?

scope.instructions: Anything beyond the P10-A gallery UI grain: flow player, pattern taxonomy, rrweb capture, artifact grid, or unrelated refactors? Is the artifact-inspection boundary honestly documented instead of claimed?

security.instructions: Does the grain weaken any control: bearer token from user input only; fully-withheld corpora read as empty with no oracle; no title leakage in UI copy; no XSS (no innerHTML/eval); no secrets; workspace auth stays server-side?

state.change: P10-A gallery UI: apps/web/app/gallery/page.tsx (products/versions over qualified REST with filter, cursors, empty/loading/error states, stable URIs) plus apps/web/tests/gallery-ui.test.mjs (5 source tests). No backend change.
